steps.text: See where your balance is heading. Tap Coach, then Reports.
Under Daily check, tap Projected Balance.
Type what you have across your accounts today.
Pick how far ahead to look. Tap 90d.
You see your balance in 90 days, and the lowest it gets along the way.
To try a plan, tap back, then Toolbox. Under Plan, tap What-If Scenarios.
Tap Savings Goal. Type your target, and what you can put away each month.
You see how long it takes, and the date you get there.
